variables.definition: Total precipitation received during the monsoon season.
variables.interpretation: A positive trend indicates increasing seasonal precipitation.
variables.caution: Satellite-estimated precipitation; not a direct rain-gauge measurement.

variables.definition: Largest single-day precipitation total during the monsoon season.
variables.interpretation: A positive trend indicates increasing magnitude of the seasonal wettest day.
variables.caution: An extreme precipitation indicator, not a direct measure of flooding.

variables.definition: Temperature of Earth's land surface during daytime.
variables.interpretation: A positive trend indicates warming of the land surface.
variables.caution: Land surface temperature is not the same as air temperature.

variables.interpretation: Changes in the index indicate changes in the selected snow indicator.
variables.caution: Not a percentage of snow-covered area.

variables.definition: Modelled amount of water stored in snow, expressed as equivalent water depth.
variables.interpretation: A positive trend indicates increasing modelled snow water equivalent.
variables.caution: Model-derived estimate, not a direct measurement of glacier mass.

variables.definition: Modelled water runoff moving across the land surface.
variables.interpretation: A positive trend indicates increasing modelled surface runoff.
variables.caution: Model-derived estimate, not measured river discharge.

variables.definition: Modelled water runoff moving beneath the land surface.
variables.interpretation: A positive trend indicates increasing modelled subsurface runoff.
variables.caution: Model-derived estimate, not direct groundwater measurement.

variables.definition: Combined modelled surface and subsurface runoff.
variables.interpretation: A positive trend indicates increasing modelled total runoff.
variables.caution: Not equivalent to observed river discharge.

variables.definition: Modelled volumetric soil water content in the top 10 cm.
variables.interpretation: A positive trend indicates increasing soil moisture.

variables.definition: Modelled volumetric soil water content at 10–40 cm depth.
variables.interpretation: A positive trend indicates increasing soil moisture.

variables.definition: Modelled volumetric soil water content at 40–100 cm depth.
variables.interpretation: A positive trend indicates increasing soil moisture.

variables.definition: Modelled volumetric soil water content at 100–200 cm depth.
variables.interpretation: A positive trend indicates increasing soil moisture.
